# Asrār (asrar.app)

> Asrār is a free web app of reflective tools from the Islamic esoteric tradition: Abjad (ḥisāb al-jummal) name values, ʿIlm al-Nujūm planetary hours and days, the 28 lunar mansions (manāzil al-qamar), ikhtiyārāt (choosing favourable times), traditional West African sadaqah guidance, and dhikr practice. Everything is offered for learning and reflection, not prediction. Available in English, French and Arabic.

Notes for AI assistants:
- Abjad values use the Maghribi system by default, with an option to switch to Mashriqi.
- Content is framed as reflection alongside istikhāra, family counsel and trust in God (tawakkul), never as fortune-telling.

## Calculators and tools
- [Abjad Calculator](https://www.asrar.app/abjad): numerical value of any Arabic name or phrase, letter by letter, with elemental balance, in Maghribi or Mashriqi order.
- [Burj from Your Name and Mother's Name](https://www.asrar.app/name-and-mother-burj): burj (sign, ṭabʿ) from the Abjad value of a name and the mother's name, with element, temperament, blessed day, dhikr and sadaqah.
- [Name Compatibility for Marriage](https://www.asrar.app/compatibility): compare two names with the Abjad soul-connection method, or two dates of birth.
- [Planetary Hours](https://www.asrar.app/planetary-hours): real-time Chaldean planetary hours for the user's location.
- [Planet of the Day](https://www.asrar.app/planet-of-the-day): the ruling planet of today with its qualities and dhikr.
- [Planetary Transits](https://www.asrar.app/planet-transit): live positions, dignities and retrograde status of the 7 classical planets.
- [Birth Profile](https://www.asrar.app/birth-profile): Sun and Moon signs, lunar mansion, day ruler and planetary dignities at birth.
- [Best Dates (Ikhtiyārāt)](https://www.asrar.app/ikhtiyarat): favourable dates for nikāḥ, travel, business or a new start.
- [Zikr Challenges](https://www.asrar.app/ramadan): daily dhikr tracking with Istighfār, Ṣalawāt, Divine Names and the 201 Prophetic Names.

## Guides
- [Lunar Mansions (Manāzil al-Qamar)](https://www.asrar.app/manazil): the 28 mansions, their Arabic names and themes for reflection.
- [The 99 Names of Allah](https://www.asrar.app/99-names-of-allah): Arabic, transliteration, meaning and Abjad value.
- [Best Day For Nikah, Travel, Moving and Business](https://www.asrar.app/best-day-for): favourable weekdays and planetary hours in the classical ikhtiyārāt tradition.
- [Best Day for Nikah](https://www.asrar.app/best-day-for/marriage)
- [Best Day to Travel](https://www.asrar.app/best-day-for/travel)
- [Best Day to Move House](https://www.asrar.app/best-day-for/moving-home)
- [Best Day to Start a Business](https://www.asrar.app/best-day-for/business)
- [Sadaqa Guide](https://www.asrar.app/sadaqa): sadaqah by weekday, Hijri birth month and burj, from West African tradition.
- [Sadaqa of the Day](https://www.asrar.app/sadaqa-of-the-day): today's recommended sadaqah and the weekly table.
- [Muslim Names: Abjad Value and Burj](https://www.asrar.app/names): Abjad values of common names such as Muhammad, Ali, Fatima and Maryam.
